title: Gridiron Golf Grip
body_html:
Authentic Football Leather for Players Who Want Texture, Not Tack

Made from the same pebble grain leather used in authentic footballs, the Gridiron Golf Grip is engineered for golfers who prefer a rough, textured surface without stickiness. If you've always liked the aggressive feel of cord grips but dislike synthetic materials (or, if you simply don't want a sticky  grip) the Gridiron delivers pure leather texture without our ProTack.

Why Choose Gridiron:

  • Authentic football leather: The same pebble grain cowhide that professional football players grip every Sunday
  • Rough, non-sticky surface: Aggressive texture without any sticky feel
  • Cord grip alternative: Natural leather roughness instead of abrasive synthetic cords
  • Consistent feel: Texture stays the same in all conditions—no moisture-activated changes
  • ProTaper design: 3-wrap buildup in lower hand for enhanced stability
  • Reminder rib: Subtle stitch seam for repeatable hand placement

Specifications:

  • Material: Pebble grain cowhide (authentic football leather)
  • Surface: Rough texture, non-sticky
  • Taper: ProTaper (reduced taper, +3 wraps lower section)
  • Sizes: Undersize, Standard, Midsize
  • Manufacturing: Handmade in USA
  • Maintenance: Brush and hot water; optional Wilson wax bar for enhanced wet-weather grip

Who This Is For: Players who want rough texture without stickiness, golfers transitioning from cord grips, those who dislike sticky grips, anyone seeking the authentic feel of football leather.

Not Right For You? If you want a tacky, all-weather grip or the softest leather feel, check out our MicroPerf Leather Golf Grip instead.
